faq.q: What can an AI voice agent actually do?
faq.a: Answer inbound calls 24/7, ask qualifying questions, answer common questions about your business, book appointments, and send the details to your CRM or team. Calls it can't handle are transferred to a person.

faq.q: Which AI models do you use?
faq.a: We choose per task, typically OpenAI or Claude models for language, and Vapi with Twilio for voice. We avoid lock-in so the model can be swapped as better options appear.

We use API providers that don't train on your data, keep personal data to the minimum the task needs, and can host parts of the system in your own cloud. We follow GDPR-friendly practices for EU and UK users.

faq.q: How much does an AI project cost to run?
faq.a: Running costs are usage-based: per call minute or per request. We estimate them during the prototype and add limits so costs stay predictable.

faq.q: Can you add AI to our existing product?
faq.a: Yes. We add AI features to existing web apps and SaaS products through APIs, without rebuilding what already works.

faq.q: How do you use AI in your own development?
faq.a: Our engineers use Claude and Cursor daily to write, test and refactor code faster. Architecture, security and final code review are always done by senior developers.

cta.p: Tell us the process or calls you want to automate. We'll reply within 24 hours with how we'd approach it.
